name: MS-70CDR
summary: Main target. About 30 custom effects, NAM and cab loaders and a patch editor, tested on firmware 2.10.

firmware.flash: Effects are installed with Zoom Effect Manager 2.3.3 or later over USB; the OS is not modified.
firmware.recovery: Remove the effect in Effect Manager. A boot freeze from a bad effect: hold the leftmost knob while powering on for All Initialize, then remove the effect.

research.label: ZoomMultistompZDL
research.note: MIT. ZDL linker, ABI notes, DSP safety rules, effects, NAM/cab template loaders, Web MIDI patch editor, Ziddle emulator tests.

research.label: repeat98/ZoomMultistompZDL
research.note: The upstream reverse-engineered toolchain the project builds on.

sdk.toolchain: TI C6000 CGT 8.5.0 (cl6x) and the ZoomMultistompZDL linker for effects; none for NAM/cab slots (browser templates).

budgets.name: DSP cost per patch
budgets.note: Summed declared cost; MS-70CDR 2.10 accepted 224.4 and refused 228.4 (measured with pass-through probes).

budgets.name: ZDL file size
budgets.note: Largest file proven to load; 32,998 froze the pedal on load.
